description: LINK-IDENTITY on a keyless source ND(A, B) with rows (1,'x'), (2,'y'), (2,'y'), (2,'z'): the link's Updatable and Indexes; a dynaset on LK moved to row 3 (the second (2,'y')), B edited to 'Y2' and updated; the source read through its own Database; then the (2,'z') row deleted through the recordset and the source read; then an Execute UPDATE WHERE A = 2 with RecordsAffected. Asks which duplicate row is chosen and whether the refusal or ambiguity is reported.
